card.statement:
Let $\sn\in \Sp\Ga$ be such that $w=\ell_{\sn}$ is $1$-singular and $w=\bar{v}+z$.

- [(i)]
There exist at most two non isomorphic irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin modules $N_1$ and $N_2$ such that $N_1(\sn)\neq 0$ and $N_2(\sn)\neq 0$.

- [(ii)]
If
$w_{ki}=w_{kj}$ then there exists a unique irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin module $N$ with $N(\sn)\neq 0$. This module appears as a subquotient of $V(T(\bar{v}))$.

- [(iii)]If $w_{rs}-w_{r-1,t}\notin \mathbb{Z}$ for any $1\leq t <r\leq n$, $1\leq s\leq r$ then $V(T(\bar{v}))$ is the unique irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin module $N$ with such that $N(\sn)\neq 0$.
card.label: Theorem 39

paper.title: Singular Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of $\displaystyle \gl(n)$
paper.abstract: The classical Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas provide a basis in terms of tableaux and an explicit action of the generators of $\mathfrak{gl} (n)$ for every irreducible finite-dimensional $\mathfrak{gl} (n)$-module. These formulas can be used to define a $\mathfrak{gl} (n)$-module structure on some infinite-dimensional modules - the so-called generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules. The generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules are convenient to work with since for every generic tableau there exists a unique irreducible generic Gelfand-Tsetlin module containing this tableau as a basis element. In this paper we initiate the systematic study of a large class of non-generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules - the class of $1$-singular Gelfand-Tsetlin modules. An explicit tableaux realization and the action of $\mathfrak{gl} (n)$ on these modules is provided using a new construction which we call derivative tableaux. Our construction of $1$-singular modules provides a large family of new irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of $\mathfrak{gl} (n)$, and is a part of the classification of all such irreducible modules for $n=3$.
